lines.speaker: supervisor_aldana
lines.text: Your desk is still assigned to you. I have been asked four times to reallocate it and I have been extremely busy on each of those four occasions.

lines.speaker: supervisor_aldana
lines.text: The budget line you queried is still being paid. Two hundred and eighty-one years, quarterly, to a counterparty with no address. I ran it myself after you left. I should not have done that and I am telling you that I did.

lines.speaker: supervisor_aldana
lines.text: There is enforcement in this Enclave that was not here last quarter, and there is no allocation entry anywhere that explains it. Whatever you did, it has an address now, and the address is my building.

lines.speaker: supervisor_aldana
lines.text: Something in the charter has changed. There is a beneficiary clause in the instrument that nobody has ever been able to source, and this quarter, for the first time in the history of this office, it can be queried.

lines.speaker: supervisor_aldana
lines.text: Allocation is tighter this quarter than any quarter on record and the Steward will not say against what. Eleven years I have read these returns. This one is a different shape and I do not have a word for the shape.

lines.speaker: supervisor_aldana
lines.text: Go, before the second Warden finishes with your face. And Auditor — whatever it is you are doing out there, the ledger is moving. I can see it move from here.
